description: WebSocket message strings in -> the [index, value] updates they make, or null if ignored.

cases.name: websocket_input
cases.description: Incoming /channel/{ch}/noteon/{note}/{vel} and /channel/{ch}/cc/{ctrl}/{value} are decoded like the equivalent MIDI messages; channels are 1-based. Note-offs (noteoff, or noteon with velocity 0) and malformed messages are ignored.

cases.name: websocket_velocity_and_pitch_bend
cases.description: noteon sets note_velocity dimensions like the equivalent MIDI note-on. /channel/{ch}/pitchbend/{value} carries the raw 14-bit value (0-16383) and is decoded like a MIDI pitch bend. Out-of-range or malformed pitch bends are ignored.
